description: Lists the project's saved versions, newest first: full snapshots of the plan (tasks, hierarchy, dates, progress, dependencies, assignments), either automatic (before large operations and every 20 minutes of editing) or saved with a name. Restoring a version is only possible in the web interface. Read-only.

projectId.description: Project id (uuid), as returned by planitude_list_projects.

name: planitude_list_versions
title: List version history
